errors.invalidFormat:
❌ Invalid duration format: **{{duration}}**

**Correct format examples:**
• `30m` - 30 minutes
• `2h` - 2 hours
• `1d` - 1 day
• `7d` - 7 days
• `30d` - 30 days

**Allowed units:** s(econds), m(inutes), h(ours), d(ays), w(eeks), mo(nths), y(ears)

💡 **Tip:** Leave duration blank for permanent ban.
